source_caption:
🎬 Facing the Giants (2006)

Facing the Giants follows Grant Taylor, a struggling high school football coach who faces overwhelming challenges both on and off the field. After years of disappointing seasons, pressure from parents, financial difficulties, and personal heartbreak, Grant begins questioning his future as a coach. Determined to turn his life around, he embraces his Christian faith and inspires his players to give their best effort regardless of the outcome. As the team begins transforming its attitude, discipline, and determination, they discover that true victory goes far beyond winning football games. Combining emotional storytelling, inspiring sports moments, and powerful messages about perseverance, the film explores faith, teamwork, courage, hope, and overcoming life’s greatest obstacles.

🎭 Genre: Sports • Drama • Faith-Based • Family

⭐ IMDb: 6.5/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 51m • PG

🎥 Director: Alex Kendrick

🏆 Recognition: Produced by Sherwood Pictures on a modest budget, the film became a successful faith-based sports drama and gained a dedicated audience for its inspirational message and memorable football scenes.

📺 Where to Watch: Check Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV, and Fandango at Home for current streaming, rental, or purchase availability. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Facing the Giants is a 2006 American Christian drama sports film directed by and starring Alex Kendrick. The supporting cast was composed of volunteers from Sherwood Baptist Church, and it is the second film that Sherwood Pictures has done. Shot in Albany, Georgia, the film tells an underdog story about American football from a Christian worldview. The film made $10.2 million on a $100,000 budget.
